questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Federated States of Micronesia?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Federated States of Micronesia article.

questions.proof: The capital city of Federated States of Micronesia is Palikir, Pohnpei.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Federated States of Micronesia?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Federated States of Micronesia on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Federated States of Micronesia article.

questions.proof: Micronesia, officially the Federated States of Micronesia, is an island nation in the Pacific Ocean, northeast of Papua New Guinea.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “In 1979, they adopted a constitution, and in _____ independence was attained under a Compact of Free Association with the United States.”

questions.proof: In 1979, they adopted a constitution, and in 1986 independence was attained under a Compact of Free Association with the United States.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Spain colonized the islands in _____, but sold them to Germany 3 years later.”
